title: Lock order reversed in TextServerAdvanced
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.7-stable

### System information

Android Emulator (API: 36-ext17)

### Issue description

A deadlock occurs when I set `use_sub_threads` in `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request` to `true` and load a complex scene.

While Thread A locks `sd->mutex` before acquiring `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_`, Thread B acquires `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_` before locking `sd->mutex`; as a result, the locking order is reversed, causing a deadlock.

### Steps to reproduce

This issue has only been observed in our production environment, and we were unable to prepare reproduction steps or an MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This issue has only been observed in our production environment, and we were unable to prepare reproduction steps or an MRP.
